passages.label: Ter. Ad. subject_1
passages.text: INTRODUCTION. This play derives its name from the two pairs of brothers who are introduced. Demea and Micio, the elders, had always been very dissimilar in character and manner of life. Micio was a pleasant old bachelor, and had always lived in town, and was very lenient and indulgent towards his young relations. Demea on the contrary had kept up the thrifty habits of his early years, residing on his farm and taking a severe view of the conduct of his sons. Ctesipho, the younger of his sons, lived with his father at this farm; but Aeschinus, the elder, had been adopted by his uncle. They had accordingly been very differently brought up. Ctesipho had been kept very strictly at home, and was, to the best of his father’s belief, a model of propriety. Aeschinus had been indulged by his uncle in every way, till he was notorious for his dissipation. He went so far at last as to offer violence to a young lady named Pamphila, whom he met one night when he was intoxicated. This was the last of his excesses. He promised to make all amends in his power by marrying Pamphila, and on this condition the matter was kept quiet by Sostrata her mother. Ctesipho in one of his visits to the town had fallen in love with a music girl belonging to a slave-merchant, and was carrying on an intercourse with her under the cover of his brother’s name; for Aeschinus had taken the credit of the affair to himself that his father might not hear of Ctesipho’s doings. After a time the slave-merchant gave notice to Ctesipho that unless he bought the music girl at his price she should be immediately sold. Ctesipho was in the greatest despair at this announcement, and was half inclined to run away from his troubles and leave the country, when Aeschinus, hearing the state of the case, cut matters short by breaking into the house of Sannio the slave-merchant, maltreating him, and carrying off the girl to his own house, where she was received by Ctesipho.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. subject_2
passages.text: Here the action of the play commences. Demea coming into town hears of this new outrage of Aeschinus’, and accuses his brother Micio of being the cause of all this excess. It was his indulgence that had made Aeschinus so dissolute. How different was the conduct of his brother Ctesipho who had been brought up strictly at home in the country! Micio in return justifies his mode of education. Meanwhile Aeschinus is busied, with the assistance of his slave Parmeno, in arranging matters with Sannio, who blusters loudly at first, but finds at last that the best plan is to pocket his affront and trust to the young men to pay him, for he will lose more by waiting to prosecute the affair, as he is on the eve of a voyage to Cyprus, than if he abandons the slave altogether. The news of Aeschinus’ prank had spread over the city, and it was now carried to Sostrata his destined mother-in-law by Geta her slave, who had witnessed the whole affair. Sostrata sends her trusty Geta to Hegio, an old friend of her late husband Simulus, who will stand by her, and see that her daughter has justice done her. Demea in the mean time is in consternation, for he has heard that Ctesipho was with Aeschinus when this music girl was carried off; but Syrus, one of Micio’s slaves, contrives, with great skill, to make the fact increase his good opinion of his son; for he represents Ctesipho to have taken part in the affair only to blame his brother’s dissolute conduct, and says that as soon as the matter was over he had returned to the country to his usual work. Demea is greatly affected to find that he has one son who is a credit to his family, and sets off for his farm. On his way he meets Hegio, from whom he learns the circumstances of Aeschinus’ connexion with Pamphila; and at the same time he finds from one of his farm servants that Ctesipho has never been to the farm at all, as Syrus had pretended. These news send him back to Micio in a rage; but he is again met with a new fiction by Syrus, who revenges himself on him by sending him on a fool’s errand over the whole town to look for his brother. Micio meanwhile has been with Hegio to Sostrata and Pamphila, and has comforted them by giving his consent to the marriage of the young lady and Aeschinus. Demea now returns from his fruitless search after his brother, and there is a general disturbance, particularly when one of the slaves accidentally betrays the fact of Ctesipho’s being in Micio’s house, where his father finds him with the music girl. After some more discussions between Demea and Micio, the former suddenly determines to change his demeanour; and to the surprise of every one whom he meets, and not a little to his own, he acts the courteous and complaisant man. He falls in with all their humours, and promotes the happiness of all parties. Pamphila is married to Aeschinus; Sannio is paid; Micio is made to marry Sostrata; Hegio is provided for; and Syrus and his wife are freed in consideration of the great services which the cunning slave had rendered to morality. The play concludes with a speech in which Demea explains the meaning of his late conduct, and gives his hearers a little wholesome advice for the future.

passages.text: Geminabit nisi caves.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 173c
passages.text: Hei misero mihi!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 174
passages.text: Non innueram: verum in istam partem potius peccato tamen.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 175
passages.text: I nunc iam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 175b
passages.text: Quid hoc rei est! regnumne Aeschine hic tu possides?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 176
passages.text: Si possiderem ornatus esses ex tuis virtutibus.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 177
passages.text: Quid tibi rei mecum est?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 177b
passages.text: Nihil.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 177c
passages.text: Quid? nostin qui sim?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 177d
passages.text: Non desidero.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 178
passages.text: Tetigin tui quicquam?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 178b
passages.text: Si attigisses ferres infortunium.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 179
passages.text: Qui tibi magis licet meam habere pro qua ego argentum dedi?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 180
passages.text: Responde.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 180b
passages.text: Ante aedes non fecisse erit melius hic convicium;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 181
passages.text: Nam si molestus pergis esse iam intro abripiere atque ibi

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 182
passages.text: Usque ad necem operiere loris.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 182b
passages.text: Loris liber?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 182c
passages.text: Sic erit.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 183
passages.text: O hominem impurum! hicine libertatem aiunt aequam esse omnibus?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 184
passages.text: Si satis iam debacchatus es leno audi si vis nunc iam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 185
passages.text: Egon debacchatus sum autem, an tu in me?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 185b
passages.text: Mitte ista, atque ad rem redi.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 186
passages.text: Quam rem? quo redeam?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 186b
passages.text: Iamne me vis dicere id quod ad te attinet?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 187
passages.text: Cupio; aequi modo aliquid.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 187b
passages.text: Vah! leno iniqua me non vult loqui.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 188
passages.text: Leno sum, fateor, pernicies communis adolescentium;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 189
passages.text: Periurus, pestis; tamen tibi a me nulla orta est iniuria.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 190
passages.text: Nam hercle etiam hoc restat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 190b
passages.text: Illuc quaeso redi quo coepisti, Aeschine.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 191
passages.text: Minis viginti tu illam emisti; quae res tibi vertat male.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 192
passages.text: Argenti tantum dabitur.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 192b
passages.text: Quid si ego tibi illam nolo vendere,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 193
passages.text: Coges me?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 193b
passages.text: Minime.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 193c
passages.text: Namque id metui.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 193d
passages.text: Neque vendendam censeo,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 194
passages.text: Quae libera est; nam ego liberali illam assero causa manu.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 195
passages.text: Nunc vide utrum vis; argentum accipere, an causam meditari tari tuam?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 196
passages.text: Delibera hoc dum ego redeo leno.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 196b
passages.text: Pro supreme Iupiter!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 197
passages.text: Minime miror qui insanire occipiunt ex iniuria.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 198
passages.text: Domo me eripuit; verberavit; me invito abduxit meam:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 199
passages.text: Homini misero plus quingentos colaphos infregit mihi.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 200
passages.text: Ob malefacta haec tantidem emtam postulat sibi tradier.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 201
passages.text: Verum enim, quando bene promeruit, fiat: suum ius postulat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 202
passages.text: Age iam cupio, si modo argentum reddat. Sed ego hoc hariolor;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 203
passages.text: Ubi me dixero dare tanti, testes faciet ilico

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 204
passages.text: Vendidisse me: de argento somnium: mox; Cras redi.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 205
passages.text: Id quoque possum ferre si modo reddat; quanquam iniurium est.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 206
passages.text: Verum cogito id quod res est: quando eum quaestum occeperis,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 207
passages.text: Accipienda et mussitanda iniuria adolescentium est.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 208
passages.text:
Sed nemo dabit: frustra has egomet mecum rationes puto.

(SYRUS. SANNIO.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 209
passages.text: Tace, egomet conveniam iam ipsum: cupide accipiat faxo; atque etiam

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 210
passages.text: Bene dicat secum esse actum. Quid istuc, Sannio, est quod te audio

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 211
passages.text: Nescio quid concertasse cum hero?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 211b
passages.text: Nunquam vidi iniquius

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 212
passages.text: Certationem comparatam quam haec hodie inter nos fuit:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 213
passages.text: Ego vapulando, ille verberando, usque ambo defessi sumus.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 214
passages.text: Tua culpa.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 214b
passages.text: Quid agerem?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 214c
passages.text: Adolescenti morem gestum oportuit.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 215
passages.text: Qui potui melius qui hodie usque os praebui?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 215b
passages.text: Age, scis quid loquar?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 216
passages.text: Pecuniam in loco negligere maximum interdum est lucrum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 216b
passages.text: Hui!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 217
passages.text: Metuisti; si nunc de tuo iure concessisses paululum, atque

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 218
passages.text: Adolescenti esses morigeratus, hominum homo stultissime,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 219
passages.text: Ne non tibi istuc foeneraret?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 219b
passages.text: Ego spem pretio non emo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 220
passages.text: Nunquam rem facies: abi: nescis inescare homines, Sannio.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 221
passages.text: Credo istuc melius esse: verum ego nunquam adeo astutus fui

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 222
passages.text: Quin quicquid possem mallem auferre potius in praesentia.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 223
passages.text: Age; novi tuum animum; quasi iam usquam tibi sint viginti minae,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 224
passages.text: Dum huic obsequare. Praeterea autem te aiunt proficisci Cyprum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 224b
passages.text: Hem!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 225
passages.text: Coëmisse hinc quae illuc veheres multa; navem conductam; hoc, scio,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 226
passages.text: Animus tibi pendet. Ubi illinc, spero, redieris tamen hoc ages.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 227
passages.text: Nusquam pedem. Perii hercle; hac illi spe hoc inceperunt.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 227b
passages.text: Timet:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 228
passages.text: Inieci scrupulum homini.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 228b
passages.text: O scelera! illud vide

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 229
passages.text: Ut in ipso articulo oppressit. Emtae mulieres

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 230
passages.text: Complures; et item hine alia quae porto Cyprum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 231
passages.text: Nisi eo ad mercatum venio, damnum maximum est.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 232
passages.text: Nunc si hoc omitto actum agam; ubi illinc rediero

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 233
passages.text: Nihil est; refrixerit res. Nunc demum venis?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 234
passages.text: Cur passus? ubi eras? Ut sit satius perdere

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 235
passages.text: Quam aut hic nunc manere tam diu, aut tum persequi.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 236
passages.text: Iamne enumerasti id quod ad te rediturum putes?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 237
passages.text: Hocine illo dignum est? hocine incipere Aeschinum?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 238
passages.text: Per oppressionem ut hanc mihi eripere postulet?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 239
passages.text: Labascit. Unum hoc habeo: vide si satis placet:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 240
passages.text: Potius quam venias in periculum, Sannio,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 241
passages.text: Servesne an perdas totum, dividuum face:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 242
passages.text: Minas decem conradet alicunde.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 242b
passages.text: Hei mihi,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 243
passages.text: Etiam de sorte nunc venio in dubium miser?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 244
passages.text: Pudet nihil: omnes dentes labefecit mihi:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 245
passages.text: Praeterea colaphis tuber est totum caput.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 246
passages.text: Etiam insuper defrudat? nusquam abeo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 246b
passages.text: Ut lubet.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 247
passages.text: Numquid vis quin abeam?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 247b
passages.text: Immo hercle hoc quaeso, Syre;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 248
passages.text: Ut ut haec sunt acta, potius quam lites sequar,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 249
passages.text: Meum mihi reddatur; saltem quanti emta est, Syre.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 250
passages.text: Scio te non usum antehac amicitia mea:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 251
passages.text: Memorem me dices esse et gratum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 251b
passages.text: Sedulo

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 252
passages.text: Faciam: sed Ctesiphonem video: laetus est

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 253
passages.text: De amica.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 253b
passages.text: Quid quod te oro?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 253c
passages.text:
Paulisper mane.

(CTESIPHO. SYRUS.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 254
passages.text: Abs quivis homine, cum est opus, beneficium accipere gaudeas:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 255
passages.text: Verum enimvero id demum iuvat, si, quem aequum est facere, is bene facit.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 256
passages.text: O frater frater, quid ego nunc te laudem? Satis certo scio;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 257
passages.text: Nunquam ita magnifice quicquam dicam id virtus quin superet tua.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 258
passages.text: Itaque unam hanc rem me habere praeter alios praecipuam arbitror,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 259
passages.text: Fratrem homini nemini esse primarum artium magis principem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 260
passages.text: O Ctesipho.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 260b
passages.text: O Syre, Aeschinus ubi est?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 260c
passages.text: Ellum, te exspectat domi.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 260d
passages.text: Hem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 261
passages.text: Quid est?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 261b
passages.text: Quid sit? illius opera, Syre, nunc vivo: festivum caput,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 262
passages.text: Qui omnia sibi post putavit esse prae meo commodo;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 263
passages.text: Maledicta, famam, meum amorem, et peccatum in se transtulit:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 264
passages.text: Nihil pote supra. Quidnam foris crepuit?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 264b
passages.text:
Mane, mane: ipse exit foras.

(AESCHINUS. SANNIO. CTESIPHO. SYRUS.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 265
passages.text: Ubi ille est sacrilegus?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 265b
passages.text: Men quaerit? numquidnam effert? Occidi:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 266
passages.text: Nihil video.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 266b
passages.text: Ehem, opportune; te ipsum quaero. Quid fit, Ctesipho?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 267
passages.text: In tuto est omnis res: omitte vero tristitiam tuam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 268
passages.text: Ego illam hercle vero omitto qui quidem te habeam fratrem. O mi Aeschine,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 269
passages.text: O mi germane; ah, vereor coram in os te laudare amplius,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 270
passages.text: Ne id assentandi magis quam quo habeam gratum facere existimes.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 271
passages.text: Age inepte; quasi nunc non norimus nos inter nos, Ctesipho.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 272
passages.text: Hoc mihi dolet, nos paene sero scisse, et paene in eum locum

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 273
passages.text: Redisse ut si omnes cuperent nihil tibi possent auxiliarier.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 274
passages.text: Pudebat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 274b
passages.text: Ah, stultitia est istaec, non pudor. Tam ob parvulam

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 275
passages.text: Rem paene ex patria!—Turpe dictu. Deos quaeso ut istaec prohibeant.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 276
passages.text: Peccavi.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 276b
passages.text: Quid ait tandem nobis Sannio?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 276c
passages.text: Iam mitis est.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 277
passages.text: Ego ad forum ibo ut hunc absolvam: tu intro ad illam, Ctesipho.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 278
passages.text: Syre, insta.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 278b
passages.text: Eamus; namque hic properat in Cyprum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 278c
passages.text: Ne tam quidem;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 279
passages.text: Quamvis etiam maneo otiosus hic.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 279b
passages.text: Reddetur; ne time.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 280
passages.text: At ut omne reddat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 280b
passages.text: Omne reddet: tace modo, ac sequere hac.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 280c
passages.text: Sequor.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 281
passages.text: Heus, heus, Syre.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 281b
passages.text: Hem, quid est?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 281c
passages.text: Obsecro hercle, hominem istum impurissimum

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 282
passages.text: Quamprimum absolvitote; ne, si magis irritatus siet,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 283
passages.text: Aliqua ad patrem hoc permanet, atque ego tum perpetuo perierim.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 284
passages.text: Non fiet; bono animo es: tu cum illa te intus oblecta interim;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 285
passages.text: Et lectulos iube sterni nobis, et parari caetera.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 286
passages.text: Ego iam transacta re convertam me domum cum obsonio.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 287
passages.text:
Ita quaeso: quando hoc bene successit, hilarem hunc sumamus diem.

(SOSTRATA. CANTHARA.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 288
passages.text: Obsecro, mea nutrix, quid nunc fiet?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 288b
passages.text: Quid fiat rogas?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 289
passages.text: Recte edepol spero.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 289b
passages.text: Modo dolores, mea tu, occipiunt primulum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 290
passages.text: Iam nunc times, quasi nunquam affueris, nunquam tute pepereris.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 291
passages.text: Miseram me, neminem habeo; solae sumus: Geta autem hic non adest;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 292
passages.text: Nec quem ad obstetricem mittam; nec qui arcessat Aeschinum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 293
passages.text: Pol is quidem iam hic aderit; nam nunquam unum intermittit diem

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 294
passages.text: Quin semper veniat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 294b
passages.text: Solus mearum miseriarum est remedium.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 295
passages.text: E re nata melius fieri haud potuit quam factum est hera;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 296
passages.text: Quando vitium oblatum est; quod ad illum attinet potissimum

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 297
passages.text: Talem, tali genere atque animo, natum ex tanta familia.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 298
passages.text:
Ita pol est ut dicis: salvus nobis Deos quaeso ut siet.

(GETA. SOSTRATA. CANTHARA.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 299
passages.text: Nunc illud est quod si omnes omnia sua consilia conferant,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 300
passages.text: Atque huic malo salutem quaerant, auxili nihil afferant,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 301
passages.text: Quod mihique heraeque filiaeque herili est. Vae misero mihi!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 302
passages.text: Tot res repente circumvallant, unde emergi non potest,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 303
passages.text: Vis, egestas, iniustitia, solitudo, infamia.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 304
passages.text: Hocine saeclum? O scelera, O genera sacrilega, O hominem impium!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 305
passages.text: Me miseram! quidnam est quod sic video timidum et properantem Getam?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 306
passages.text: Quem neque fides neque iusiurandum neque illum misericordia

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 307
passages.text: Repressit neque reflexit, neque quod partus instabat prope,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 308
passages.text: Cui miserae indigne per vim vitium obtulerat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 308b
passages.text: Non intelligo

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 309
passages.text: Satis quae loquatur.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 309b
passages.text: Propius obsecro accedamus, Sostrata.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 309c
passages.text: Ah,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 310
passages.text: Me miserum! vix sum compos animi; ita ardeo iracundia.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 311
passages.text: Nihil est quod malim quam illam totam familiam mihi dari obviam,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 312
passages.text: Ut ego iram hanc in eos evomam omnem dum aegritudo haec est recens:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 313
passages.text: Satis mihi id habeam supplici, dum illos ulciscar modo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 314
passages.text: Seni animam primum extinguerem ipsi qui illud produxit scelus.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 315
passages.text: Tum autem Syrum impulsorem, vah, quibus illum lacerarem modis!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 316
passages.text: Sublimem medium arriperem, et capite pronum in terram statuerem,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 317
passages.text: Ut cerebro dispergat viam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 318
passages.text: Adolescenti ipsi eriperem oculos; posthaec praecipitem darem;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 319
passages.text: Caeteros ruerem, agerem, raperem, tunderem, et prosternerem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 320
passages.text: Sed cesso heram hoc malo impertiri propere?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 320b
passages.text: Revocemus. Geta.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 321
passages.text: Hem, quisquis es, sine me.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 321b
passages.text: Ego sum Sostrata.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 321c
passages.text: Ubi ea est? te ipsam quaerito,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 322
passages.text: Te expecto: oppido opportune te obtulisti mihi obviam,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 323
passages.text: Hera.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 323b
passages.text: Quid est? quid trepidas?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 323c
passages.text: Hei mihi!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 323d
passages.text: Quid festinas, mi Geta?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 324
passages.text: Animam recipe.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 324b
passages.text: Prorsus—

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 324c
passages.text: Quid istuc prorsus ergo est.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 324d
passages.text: Periimus:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 325
passages.text: Actum est.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 325b
passages.text: Eloquere ergo, obsecro te, quid sit.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 325c
passages.text: Iam—

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 325d
passages.text: Quid iam, Geta?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 326
passages.text: Aeschinus—

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 326b
passages.text: Quid is ergo?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 326c
passages.text: alienus est ab nostra familia.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 326d
passages.text: Hem,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 327
passages.text: Perii: quare?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 327b
passages.text: Amare occepit aliam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 327c
passages.text: Vae miserae mihi!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 328
passages.text: Neque id occulte fert: ab lenone ipsus eripuit palam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 329
passages.text: Satin hoc certum est?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 329b
passages.text: Certum: hisce oculis egomet vidi, Sostrata.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 329c
passages.text: Ah,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 330
passages.text: Me miseram! quid credas iam? aut cui credas? Nostrumne Aeschinum;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 331
passages.text: Nostram vitam omnium, in quo nostrae spes omnesque opes sitae

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 332
passages.text: Erant; qui sine hac iurabat se unum nunquam victurum diem;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 333
passages.text: Qui se in sui gremio positurum puerum dicebat patris;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 334
passages.text: Ita obsecraturum ut liceret sibi hanc uxorem ducere?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 335
passages.text: Hera, lacrimas mitte, ac potius quod ad hanc rem opus est porro consule;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 336
passages.text: Patiamurne, an narremus cuipiam?

passages.text: Ita fiat, et istoc si quid potis est rectius.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 521b
passages.text: Ita: nam hunc diem

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 522
passages.text: Misere nimis cupio, ut coepi, perpetuum in laetitia degere:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 523
passages.text: Et illud rus nulla alia causa tam male odi, nisi quia prope est:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 524
passages.text: Quod si abesset longius,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 525
passages.text: Prius nox oppressisset illic quam huc reverti posset iterum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 526
passages.text: Nunc ubi me illic non videbit iam huc recurret, sat scio.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 527
passages.text: Rogitabit me ubi fuerim; quem ego hodie toto non vidi die.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 528
passages.text: Quid dicam?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 528b
passages.text: Nihilne in mentem?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 528c
passages.text: Nunquam quicquam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 528d
passages.text: Tanto nequior.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 529
passages.text: Cliens, amicus, hospes, nemo est vobis?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 529b
passages.text: Sunt: quid postea ?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 530
passages.text: Hisce opera ut data sit.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 530b
passages.text: Quae non data sit? non potest fieri.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 530c
passages.text: Potest.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 531
passages.text: Interdiu: sed si hic pernocto, causae quid dicam, Syre?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 532
passages.text: Vah, quam vellem etiam noctu amicis operam mos esset dari.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 533
passages.text: Quin tu otiosus es: ego illius sensum pulchre calleo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 534
passages.text: Quum fervit maxime tam placidum quam ovem reddo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 534b
passages.text: Quo modo?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 535
passages.text: Laudarier te audit libenter: facio te apud illum Deum:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 536
passages.text: Virtutes narro.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 536b
passages.text: Meas?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 536c
passages.text: Tuas: homini ilico lacrimae cadunt

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 537
passages.text: Quasi puero gaudio. Hem tibi autem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 537b
passages.text: Quidnam est?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 537c
passages.text: Lupus in fabula.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 538
passages.text: Pater est?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 538c
passages.text: Syre, quid agimus?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 538d
passages.text: Fuge modo intro: ego videro.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 539
passages.text: Si quid rogabit, nusquam tu me: audistin?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 539b
passages.text:
Potin ut desinas?

(DEMEA. CTESIPHO. SYRUS.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 540
passages.text: Nae ego homo sum infelix: primum fratrem nusquam invenio gentium:

passages.text: Praeterea autem dum illum quaero a villa mercenarium

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 542
passages.text: Vidi: is filium negat esse ruri: nec quid agam scio.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 543
passages.text: Syre.

passages.text: Quid est?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 543f

passages.text: Quid hoc, malum, infelicitatis? nequeo satis decernere;

passages.text: Nisi me credo huic esse natum rei, ferendis miseriis.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 546
passages.text: Primus sentio mala nostra; primus rescisco omnia;

passages.text: Primus porro obnuntio: aegre solus si quid fit fero.

passages.text: Nunc redeo: si forte frater redierit viso.

passages.text: Obsecro vide ne ille huc prorsus se irruat.

passages.text: Etiam taces?

passages.text: Ego cavebo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 551b
passages.text: Nunquam hercle hodie ego istuc committam tibi;

passages.text: Nam me iam in cellam aliquam cum illa concludam: id tutissimum est.

passages.text: Age, tamen ego hunc amovebo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 553b
passages.text: Sed eccum sceleratum Syrum.

passages.text: Non hercle hic quidem durare quisquam, si sic fit, potest.

passages.text: Scire equidem volo quot mihi sint domini: quae haec est miseria?

passages.text: Quid ille gannit? quid vult? quid ais bone vir? est frater domi?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 557
passages.text: Quid, malum, Bone vir, mihi narras? Equidem perii.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 557b
passages.text: Quid tibi est?

passages.text: Rogitas? Ctesipho me pugnis miserum et istam psaltriam

passages.text: Usque occidit.

passages.text: Hem, quid narras?

passages.text: Quamobrem?

passages.text: Produxe aibas?

passages.text: Nihil pepercit. Non puduisse verberare hominem senem,

passages.text: Quem ego modo puerum tantillum in manibus gestavi meis?

passages.text: Laudo, Ctesipho; patrissas: abi, virum te iudico.

passages.text: Laudas? Nae ille continebit posthac si sapiet manus.

passages.text: Perquam! quia miseram mulierem, et me servulum

passages.text: Qui referire non audebam, vicit: hui, perfortiter!

passages.text: Non potuit melius: idem quod ego sensit te esse huic rei caput.

passages.text: Sed estne frater intus?

passages.text: Nostin porticum apud macellum hanc deorsum?

passages.text: Ad sinistram hac recta platea: ubi ad Dianae veneris

passages.text: I sane. Ego te exercebo hodie ut dignus es, silicernium.

passages.text: Aeschinus odiose cessat: prandium corrumpitur.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 589
passages.text: Ctesipho autem in amore est totus. Ego iam prospiciam mihi:

passages.text: Nam iam adibo, atque unumquicquid quod quidem erit bellissimum

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 591
passages.text:
Carpam; et cyathos sorbilans paulatim hunc producam diem.

(MICIO. HEGIO.)

passages.text: Ego in hac re nihil reperio quamobrem lauder tantopere, Hegio:

passages.text: Meum officium facio; quod peccatum a nobis ortum est corrigo:

passages.text: Nisi si me in illo credidisti esse hominum numero qui ita putant,

passages.text: Sibi fieri iniuriam ultro si quam fecere ipsi expostules,

passages.text: Et ultro accusant: id quia non est a me factum agis gratias?

passages.text: Nam et illi animum iam relevabis, quae dolore ac miseria

passages.text: Tabescit; et tuo officio fueris functus: sed si aliter putas,

passages.text: Egomet narrabo quae mihi dixti.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 604b
passages.text: Immo ego ibo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 604c
passages.text: Bene facis.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 605
passages.text: Omnes quibus res sunt minus secundae magis sunt nescio quomodo

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 606
passages.text: Suspiciosi; ad contumeliam omnia accipiunt magis;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 607
passages.text: Propter suam impotentiam se semper credunt negligi;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 608
passages.text: Quapropter te ipsum purgare ipsis coram placabilius est.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 609
passages.text: Et recte et verum dicis.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 609b
passages.text: Sequere me ergo hac intro.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 609c
passages.text:
Maxime.

(AESCHINUS.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 610
passages.text: Discrucior animi:

passages.text: Hocine de improviso mali mihi obiici

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 612
passages.text: Tantum, ut neque quid de me faciam neque quid agam certum siet!

passages.text: Membra metu debilia sunt; animus timore

passages.text: Obstipuit: pectore consistere nil consili

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 615
passages.text: Quit. Vah! quomodo me ex hac expediam turba? Tanta nunc

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 616
passages.text: Suspicio de me incidit;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 617
passages.text: Neque ea immerito: Sostrata credit mihi me psaltriam hanc emisse.

passages.text: Id anus mihi indicium fecit.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 619
passages.text: Nam ut hinc forte ea ad obstetricem erat missa, ubi eam vidi ilico

passages.text: Accedo, rogito Pamphila quid agat, iam partus adsiet;

passages.text: Eone obstetricem arcessat. Illa exclamat, Abi, abi iam, Aeschine.

passages.text: Satis diu dedisti verba; sat adhuc tua nos frustrata est fides.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 623

passages.text: Sensi ilico id illas suspicari: sed me reprehendi tamen

passages.text: Ne quid de fratre garrulae illi dicerem, ac fieret palam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 626
passages.text: Nunc quid faciam? Dicam fratris esse? Id quidem minime est opus

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 627
passages.text: Usquam efferri. Ac mitto: fieri potis est ut ne qua exeat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 628
passages.text: Ipsum id metuo ut credant; tot concurrunt verisimilia.

passages.text: Egomet rapui; ipse egomet solvi argentum; ad me abducta est domum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 630
passages.text: Haec adeo mea culpa fateor fieri. Non me hanc rem patri

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 631
passages.text: Ut ut erat gesta indicasse? Exorassem ut eam ducerem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 632
passages.text: Cessatum usque adhuc est: nunc porro, Aeschine, expergiscere!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 633
passages.text: Nunc hoc primum est: ad illas ibo ut purgem me; accedam ad fores.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 634
passages.text: Perii! horresco semper ubi pultare hasce occipio miser.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 635
passages.text: Heus, heus: Aeschinus ego sum: aperite aliquis actutum ostium.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 636
passages.text:
Prodit nescio quis: concedam huc.

(MICIO. AESCHINUS.)

passages.text: Ita uti dixi, Sostrata,

passages.text: Quid huic hic negoti est?

passages.text: Quandoquidem hoc nunquam mihi ipse voluit credere.

passages.text: Perge.

passages.text: Hic meus amicus illi genere est proximus:

passages.text: Huic leges cogunt nubere hanc.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 653b
passages.text: Perii.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 653c
passages.text: Quid est?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 654
passages.text: Nihil: recte: perge.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 654b
passages.text: Is venit ut secum avehat;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 655
passages.text: Nam habitat Mileti.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 655b
passages.text: Hem, virginem ut secum avehat?

passages.text: Sic est.

passages.text: Miletum usque obsecro?

passages.text: Quid ipsae? quid aiunt?

passages.text: Virginem vitiasti quam te ius non fuerat tangere.

passages.text: Iam id peccatum primum magnum; magnum, at humanum tamen.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 689
passages.text: Fecere alii saepe item boni: at postquam id evenit, cedo

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 690
passages.text: Numquid circumspexti? aut numquid tute prospexti tibi,

passages.text: Quid fieret, qua fieret? si te ipsum mihi puduit dicere,

passages.text: Qua resciscerem? Haec dum dubitas menses abierunt decem.

passages.text: Prodidisti et te, et illam miseram, et gnatum, quod quidem in te fuit.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 694
passages.text: Quid? credebas dormienti haec tibi confecturos Deos,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 695
passages.text: Et illam sine tua opera in cubiculum iri deductum domum?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 696
passages.text: Nolim ceterarum rerum te socordem eodem modo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 697
passages.text: Bono animo es: duces uxorem hanc.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 697b
passages.text: Hem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 697d

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 700
passages.text: Abi domum, ac Deos comprecare ut uxorem arcessas: abi.

passages.text: Quid? iam uxorem?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 701e

passages.text: Omnes oderint ni magis te quam oculos nunc amo meos.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 703

(DEMEA.)

Certum obsidere est usque donec redierit.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 860
passages.text: Quod nunc mihi evenit; nam ego vitam duram quam vixi usque adhuc

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 861
passages.text: Prope iam excurso spatio mitto. Id quamobrem? Re ipsa repperi

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 862
passages.text: Facilitate nihil esse homini melius neque clementia.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 863
passages.text: Id esse verum ex me atque ex fratre cuivis facile est noscere.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 864
passages.text: Ille suam semper egit vitam in otio, in conviviis,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 865
passages.text: Clemens, placidus, nulli laedere os, arridere omnibus:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 866
passages.text: Sibi vixit; sibi sumtum fecit: omnes bene dicunt, amant.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 867
passages.text: Ego ille agrestis, saevus, tristis, parcus, truculentus, tenax,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 868
passages.text: Duxi uxorem: quam ibi miseriam vidi! Nati filii,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 869
passages.text: Alia cura. Porro autem illis dum studeo ut quam plurimum

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 870
passages.text: Facerem, contrivi in quaerendo vitam atque aetatem meam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 871
passages.text: Nunc exacta aetate hoc fructi pro labore ab his fero,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 872
passages.text: Odium. Ille alter sine labore patria potitur commoda:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 873
passages.text: Illum amant, me fugitant: illi credunt consilia omnia;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 874
passages.text: Illum diligunt; apud illum sunt ambo: ego desertus sum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 875
passages.text: Illum ut vivat optant; meam autem mortem exspectant. Scilicet

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 876
passages.text: Ita eos meo labore eductos maximo hic fecit suos

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 877
passages.text: Paulo sumptu: miseriam omnem ego capio; hic potitur gaudia.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 878
passages.text: Age, age, nunc iam experiamur porro contra quid ego possiem

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 879
passages.text: Blande dicere, aut benigne facere, quando eo provocat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 880
passages.text: Ego quoque a meis me amari et magni pendi postulo:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 881
passages.text: Si id fit dando atque obsequendo, non posteriores feram.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 882
passages.text:
Deerit. Id mea minime refert qui sum natu maximus.

(SYRUS. DEMEA.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 883
passages.text: Heus, Demea, rogat frater ne abeas longius.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 884
passages.text: Quis homo? O Syre noster salve: quid fit? quid agitur?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 885
passages.text: Recte.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 885b
passages.text: Optime est. Iam nunc haec tria primum addidi

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 886
passages.text: Praeter naturam: O noster! quid fit? quid agitur?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 887
passages.text: Servum haud illiberalem praebes te; et tibi

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 888
passages.text: Libens bene faxim.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 888b
passages.text: Gratiam habeo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 888c
passages.text: Atqui, Syre,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 889
passages.text:
Hoc verum est; et ipsa re experiere propediem.

(GETA. DEMEA.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 890
passages.text: Hera, ego huc ad hos provisam quam mox virginem

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 891
passages.text: Arcessant: sed eccum Demeam. Salvus sies.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 892
passages.text: O, qui vocare?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 892b
passages.text: Geta.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 892c
passages.text: Geta, hominem maximi

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 893
passages.text: Preti te esse hodie animo iudicavi meo:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 894
passages.text: Nam is mihi profecto est servus spectatus satis

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 895
passages.text: Cui dominus curae est, ita uti tibi sensi, Geta:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 896
passages.text: Et tibi ob eam rem, si quid usus venerit,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 897
passages.text: Libens bene faxim. Meditor esse affabilis;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 898
passages.text: Et bene procedit.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 898b
passages.text: Bonus es quum hace existimas.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 899
passages.text:
Paulatim plebem primulum facio meam.

(AESCHINUS. DEMEA. SYRUS. GETA.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 900
passages.text: Occidunt me quidem dum nimis sanctas nuptias

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 901
passages.text: Student facere: in apparando consumunt diem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 902
passages.text: Quid agitur, Aeschine?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 902b
passages.text: Ehem, pater mi, tu hic eras?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 903
passages.text: Tuus hercle vero et animo et natura pater,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 904
passages.text: Qui te amat plus quam hosce oculos: sed cur non domum

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 905
passages.text: Uxorem arcessis?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 905b
passages.text: Cupio: verum hoc mihi morae est;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 906
passages.text: Tibicina, et Hymenaeum qui cantent.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 906b
passages.text: Eho,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 907
passages.text: Vin tu huic seni auscultare?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 907b
passages.text: Quid?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 907c
passages.text: Missa haec face,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 908
passages.text: Hymenaeum, turbas, lampadas, tibicinas;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 909
passages.text: Atque hanc in horto maceriam iube dirui,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 910
passages.text: Quantum potest; hac transfer; unam fac domum;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 911
passages.text: Traduce et matrem et familiam omnem ad nos.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 911b
passages.text: Placet,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 912
passages.text: Pater lepidissime.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 912b
passages.text: Euge! iam lepidus vocor.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 913
passages.text: Fratri aedes fient perviae: turbam domum

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 914
passages.text: Adducet; sumtum admittet; multa. Quid mea?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 915
passages.text: Ego lepidus ineo gratiam. Iube nunc iam

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 916
passages.text: Dinumeret illi Babylo viginti minas.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 917
passages.text: Syre, cessas ire ac facere?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 917b
passages.text: Quid ago?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 917c
passages.text: Dirue.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 918
passages.text: Tu illas abi et traduce.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 918b
passages.text: Di tibi, Demea,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 919
passages.text: Bene faciant quum te video nostrae familiae

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 920
passages.text: Tam ex animo factum velle.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 920b
passages.text: Dignos arbitror.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 921
passages.text: Quid ais tu?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 921b
passages.text: Sic opinor.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 921c
passages.text: Multo rectius est

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 922
passages.text: Quam illam puerperam nunc duci huc per viam

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 923
passages.text: Aegrotam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 923b
passages.text: Nihil enim vidi melius, mi pater.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 924
passages.text:
Sic soleo: sed eccum Micio egreditur foras.

(MICIO. DEMEA. AESCHINUS.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 925
passages.text: Iubet frater? ubi is est? Tun iubes hoc, Demea?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 926
passages.text: Ego vero iubeo et in hac re et aliis omnibus

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 927
passages.text: Quam maxime unam facere nos hanc familiam,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 928
passages.text: Colere, adiuvare, adiungere.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 928b
passages.text: Ita quaeso, pater.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 929
passages.text: Haud aliter censeo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 929b
passages.text: Immo hercle ita nobis decet.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 930
passages.text: Primum huius uxoris est mater.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 930b
passages.text: Quid postea?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 931
passages.text: Proba et modesta.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 931b
passages.text: Ita aiunt.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 931c
passages.text: Natu grandior.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 932
passages.text: Scio.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 932b
passages.text: Parere iam diu haec per annos non potest;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 933
passages.text: Nec qui eam respiciat quisquam est: sola est.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 933b
passages.text: Quam hic rem agit?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 934
passages.text: Hanc te aequum est ducere; et te operam ut fiat dare.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 935
passages.text: Me ducere autem?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 935b
passages.text: Te.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 935c
passages.text: Me?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 935d
passages.text: Te inquam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 935e
passages.text: Ineptis.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 935f
passages.text: Si tu sis homo,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 936
passages.text: Hic faciat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 936b
passages.text: Mi pater.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 936c
passages.text: Quid? tu autem huic, asine, auscultas?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 936d
passages.text: Nihil agis:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 937
passages.text: Fieri aliter non potest.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 937b
passages.text: Deliras.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 937c
passages.text: Sine te exorem, mi pater.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 938
passages.text: Insanis: aufer.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 938b
passages.text: Age da veniam filio.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 938c
passages.text: Satin sanus es? ego

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 939
passages.text: Novus maritus anno demum quinto et sexagesimo

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 940
passages.text: Fiam, atque anum decrepitam ducam? Idne estis auctores mihi?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 941
passages.text: Fac: promisi ego illis.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 941b
passages.text: Promisti autem? de te largitor, puer.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 942
passages.text: Age; quid si quid te maius oret?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 942b
passages.text: Quasi non hoc sit maximum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 943
passages.text: Da veniam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 943b
passages.text: Ne gravere.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 943c
passages.text: Fac promitte.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 943d
passages.text: Non omittis?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 944
passages.text: Non, nisi te exorem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 944b
passages.text: Vis est haec quidem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 944c
passages.text: Age prolixe, Micio.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 945
passages.text: Etsi hoc mihi pravum, ineptum, absurdum, atque alienum a vita mea

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 946
passages.text: Videtur, si vos tantopere istuc vultis, fiat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 946b
passages.text: Bene facis:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 947
passages.text: Merito te amo. Verum—

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 947b
passages.text: Quid?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 947c
passages.text: Ego dicam, hoc quum fit quod volo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 948
passages.text: Quid nunc quod restat? Hegio his est cognatus proximus,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 949
passages.text: Affinis nobis, pauper: bene nos aliquid facere illi decet.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 950
passages.text: Quid facere?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 950b
passages.text: Agelli est hic sub urbe paulum, quod locitas foras:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 951
passages.text: Huic demus qui fruatur.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 951b
passages.text: Paulum id autem?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 951c
passages.text: Si multum est, tamen

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 952
passages.text: Faciendum est: pro patre huic est; bonus est; noster est; recte datur.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 953
passages.text: Postremo nunc meum illud verbum facio quod tu, Micio,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 954
passages.text: Bene et sapienter dixti dudum: Vitium commune omnium est,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 955
passages.text: Quod nimium ad rem in senecta attenti sumus. Hanc maculam nos decet

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 956
passages.text: Effugere: dictum est vere, et re ipsa fieri oportet .

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 957
passages.text: Quid istic? dabitur quandoquidem hic vult.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 957b
passages.text: Mi pater.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 958
passages.text: Nunc tu mihi es germanus pariter corpore et animo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 958b
passages.text: Gaudeo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 959
passages.text:
Suo sibi gladio hunc iugulo.

(SYRUS. DEMEA. MICIO. AESCHINUS.)

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 959b
passages.text: Factum est quod iussisti, Demea.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 960
passages.text: Frugi homo es. Ego edepol hodie mea quidem sententia

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 961
passages.text: Iudico Syrum fieri esse aequum liberum.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 961b
passages.text: Istunc liberum?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 962
passages.text: Quodnam ob factum?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 962b
passages.text: Multa.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 962c
passages.text: O noster Demea, edepol vir bonus es.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 963
passages.text: Ego istos vobis usque a pueris curavi ambos sedulo;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 964
passages.text: Docui, monui, bene praecepi semper quae potui omnia.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 965
passages.text: Res apparet. Et quidem porro haec; obsonare cuni fide,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 966
passages.text: Scortum adducere, apparare de die convivium;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 967
passages.text: Non mediocris hominis haec sunt officia.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 967b
passages.text: O lepidum caput!

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 968
passages.text: Postremo, hodie in psaltria hac emenda hic adiutor fuit,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 969
passages.text: Hic curavit: prodesse aequum est: alii meliores erunt:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 970
passages.text: Denique hic vult fieri.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 970b
passages.text: Vin tu hoc fieri?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 970c
passages.text: Cupio.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 970d
passages.text: Si quidem

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 971
passages.text: Tu vis, Syre, eho accede huc ad me: liber esto.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 971b
passages.text: Bene facis.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 972
passages.text: Omnibus gratiam habeo, et seorsum tibi praeterea, Demea.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 973
passages.text: Gaudeo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 973b
passages.text: Et ego.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 973c
passages.text: Credo: utinam hoc perpetuum fiat gaudium,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 974
passages.text: Phrygiam ut uxorem meam una mecum videam liberam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 975
passages.text: Optimam quidem mulierem.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 975b
passages.text: Et quidem tuo nepoti, huius filio,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 976
passages.text: Hodie primam mammam dedit haec.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 976b
passages.text: Hercle vero serio,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 977
passages.text: Si quidem primam dedit, haud dubium quin emitti aequum siet.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 978
passages.text: Ob eam rem?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 978b
passages.text: Ob eam. Postremo a me argentum quanti est sumito.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 979
passages.text: Di tibi, Demea, omnes semper omnia optata offerant.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 980
passages.text: Syre, processisti hodie pulchre.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 980b
passages.text: Si quidem porro, Micio,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 981
passages.text: Tu tuum officium facies, atque huic aliquid paulum prae manu

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 982
passages.text: Dederis unde utatur; reddet tibi cito.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 982b
passages.text: Istoc vilius.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 983
passages.text: Frugi homo est.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 983b
passages.text: Reddam hercle; da modo.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 983c
passages.text: Age pater.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 983d
passages.text: Post consulam.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 984
passages.text: Faciet.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 984b
passages.text: O vir optime.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 984c
passages.text: O mi pater festivissime.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 985
passages.text: Quid istuc? quae res tam repente mores mutavit tuos?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 986
passages.text: Quod prolubium? quae istaec subita est largitas?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 986b
passages.text: Dicam tibi;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 987
passages.text: Ut id ostenderem quod te isti facilem et festivum putant,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 988
passages.text: Id non fieri ex vera vita, neque adeo ex aequo et bono:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 989
passages.text: Sed ex assentando, indulgendo, et largiendo, Micio.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 990
passages.text: Nunc adeo si ob eam rem vobis vita mea invisa est, Aeschine,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 991
passages.text: Quia non iusta iniusta prorsus omnia omnino obsequor,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 992
passages.text: Missa facio: effundite, emite, facite, quod vobis libet:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 993
passages.text: Sed si id vultis potius, quae vos propter adolescentiam

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 994
passages.text: Minus videtis, magis impense cupitis, consulitis parum,

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 995
passages.text: Haec reprehendere et corrigere me, et obsecundare in loco;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 996
passages.text: Ecce me qui id faciam vobis.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 996b
passages.text: Tibi, pater, permittimus:

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 997
passages.text: Plus scis quid facto opus est. Sed de fratre quid fiet?

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 997b
passages.text: Sino;

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 998
passages.text: Habeat; in istac finem faciat.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 998b
passages.text: Istuc recte.

passages.label: Ter. Ad. 998c
passages.text: Plaudite.
